name: HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
AGENDA
HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  TUESDAY JULY 2, 2019 AT 7:00 P.M.

  REGULAR MEETING
  ALHAMBRA CITY HALL
  111 S. FIRST ST.
  ALHAMBRA, CA 91801

1. ROLL CALL:

2. MINUTES – Approval of the minutes for the Regular Meeting of April 2, 2019.

3. PROGRESS REPORTS
  Attached for the Committee’s review are copies of the Progress Reports for those programs
  utilizing Community Development Block Grant and HOME Funds. All figures indicate the
  progress made and services rendered to date for FY 2018-2019.

   Community Services - Case Management
   150 Case Management clients were served.
   184 Volunteer Hours of assistance were donated to the program.

   Management Services - Code Enforcement
   The Code Enforcement Division investigated a total of 877 complaints.
   729 were in areas identified as in low- to moderate-income areas.
   Code Enforcement staff referred 120 to the Housing Department programs.

   Development Services - Fair Housing
   The Housing Rights Center served 364 clients.
   A variety of issues were discussed, including: evictions, security deposits, rent
  increases, repairs, contract questions, etc.

   Development Services - Housing Programs
   First-Time Home Buyer - HOME: 13 searching for a home, 0 escrows closed.
   HOME Major Rehabilitation: 1 in process, 3 completed.
   CDBG Minor Rehabilitation: 1 in process, 2 completed.

  Recommended Action
  Receive and file these informational reports.

4. 2018-2019 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN PROGRAM PREPARATION AND REVIEW –
  FAIR HOUSING SERVICES
  Each year, in preparation for the Annual Action Plan, staff presents the current and possible
  new programs to receive Community Development Block Grant or HOME funds in the
  coming program year. This gives the Housing and Community Development Act Citizen’s
  Advisory Committee and the community an opportunity to see the programs offered by the
  City of Alhambra and preview any new or proposed projects/programs being considered for
  funding. Representatives from the Housing Rights Center will be presenting information on
  the fair housing services they provide.
 5. 2018-2019 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN PROGRAM PREPARATION AND REVIEW –
  CASE MANAGEMENT
  Representatives of the Case Management Program will be presenting information on the
  services they provide.

6. COMMENTS FROM THE AUDIENCE
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain
  to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee. Public comments pertaining to
  the HCDA Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to five
  (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee’s secretary.

7. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM THE COMMITTEE
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee.

8. ADJOURNMENT

 Copies of the staff report or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
 herein above are on file in the office of Management Services, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street,
 Alhambra, CA, and are available for public inspection during regular office hours: 8:00 A.M. to 5:00
 P.M., Monday through Friday.

 Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
 described herein, he or she may contact Julio Donare, Committee Secretary, either in person, at the
 Management Services Department located at City Hall, or call via telephone at (626) 570-5011, during
 regular business hours.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: If you require special assistance to participate in any City
 meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office (626) 570-5090. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to
 the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
 meeting.
